name: Star Charter Pro
statusNote: Shipped and live; split into its own repo from star-charter on 2026-06-23, carrying its 230-line design doc in as the source of truth.
oneLiner: The timed-pressure, build-crafting edition of Star Charter — a larger upgrade pool, weapons, soft sectors, probe select, and a persistent local leaderboard.
stack: desktop-first (touch out of scope for v1)

components.name: Star Charter engine
components.desc: Reuses the original render loop, spawn director, refit system, and save layer as-is — explicit do-not-rebuild rule.

components.name: Control system
components.desc: Rewritten to direct-follow with an 80px arrive dead-zone, hard speed cap, and a Focus slow-precision mode.

components.name: Upgrade pool
components.desc: ~16 upgrades across four lanes (Movement, Survivability, Charting, Weapons), plus Motes feeding the Magnet Coil.

components.name: Probes
components.desc: Surveyor vs Skimmer — tuning presets over the same knobs.

components.name: New hazards
components.desc: Pulsar (telegraphed sweeping beam, plate 13+) and Asteroid Belt (telegraphed stream, plate 8+).

components.name: Attract mode
components.desc: An AI probe seeks motes and steers from hazards on the title screen.

dataFlow: Pointer position (no hold needed) drives direct-follow acceleration with a dead-zone.
The Focus modifier check applies, then drag and velocity integrate.
Waypoint proximity charts the star; HUD and plate state update.
Attract mode substitutes an AI controller for the pointer feed into the identical pipeline.
integrations: Shares font/style conventions with star-charter; no shared code file — a fully independent copy diverged after the split
decisions: Explicit keep-vs-cut discipline: the existing engine is reused as-is, expansion is additive only.
Weapon pool capped at exactly 3 distinct auto-weapon types — a guardrail against combat overshadowing the chart-not-kill verb.
Documented mid-build self-corrections (Phase Veil dodge cap lowered 4 to 3; Quick Plot redefined).
A parked-not-now list keeps alt controls, boss plates, meta-progression, and mobile explicitly out of scope.
